translations.web: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
translations.bsb: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.
translations.kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
translations.asv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without the law: and as many as have sinned under the law shall be judged by the law;
